resources.name: Rate Limit (Console)
resources.description:
# Rate Limit

- Allowed requests (e.g. 100 max)
  - Ratelimit-Limit: 100
- Available requests (e.g. 99 remaining)
  - Ratelimit-Remaining: 99
- Seconds until request limit reset:
  - Ratelimit-Reset: 45

Example:

```
curl -i --request GET \
     --url 'https://api.render.com/v1/services?limit=1' \
     --header "Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_TOKEN"

> HTTP/1.1 200 OK
> Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
> Ratelimit-Limit: 100
> Ratelimit-Remaining: 99
> Ratelimit-Reset: 45
```
(https://api-docs.render.com/reference/rate-limiting)

resources.name: Postgres Read
resources.description:
# List PostgreSQL Instances
- You can use the postgres id to delete it later, e.g.
   - "id": "dpg-d0ds2cc9c44c738f48hg-a",

Example:

```
curl --request GET \
     --url 'https://api.render.com/v1/postgres?includeReplicas=true&limit=20' \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header "Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_TOKEN"
```
(https://api-docs.render.com/reference/list-postgres)

resources.name: Postgres Delete
resources.description:
# Delete PostgreSQL Instance

https://api.render.com/v1/postgres/{postgresId}

- You need the postgres id of the instance to delete it, e.g.
   - "id": "dpg-d0ds2cc9c44c738f48hg-a",

Example:

```
curl --request DELETE \
     --url https://api.render.com/v1/postgres/{postgresId}\
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header "Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_TOKEN"
```
(https://api-docs.render.com/reference/delete-postgres)

resources.name: Postgres Create
resources.description:
# Create PostgreSQL Instance

- NOTE:
   - The version must be specified. The latest is v16. You can only find this by
	   checking the UI as you go to manually create one.
	 - You'll need to look for 

- TODO:
   - try including the region explicitly:
      - "region": "oregon",
   - is databaseName optional? It should have a default, but...
	 - is databaseUser optional? It should have a default, but...

Example:

```
curl --request POST \
     --url https://api.render.com/v1/postgres \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --header "Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_TOKEN" \
     --data "{
  \"name\": \"render-deploy\",
  \"ownerId\": \"$OWNER_ID\",
  \"databaseName\": \"render_deploy\",
  \"databaseUser\": \"render_user\",
  \"enableHighAvailability\": false,
  \"plan\": \"free\",
  \"version\": \"16\"
}"
```
(https://api-docs.render.com/reference/create-postgres)

resources.name: Postgres Connection Info
resources.description:
# Postgres connection info

https://api.render.com/v1/postgres/{postgresId}/connection-info

- You need the postgres id of the instance, e.g.
  - "id": "dpg-d0ds2cc9c44c738f48hg-a",
- You need to update the deployments with a postgres dependency by updating their URL using the internalConnectinString value, e.g.
  - "internalConnectionString": "postgresql://render_deploy_user:AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz123456@dpg-somehost1234someurl-a/render_deploy_name",

Example:

```
curl --request GET \
     --url https://api.render.com/v1/postgres/postgresId/connection-info \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header "Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_API_TOKEN"
```
(https://api-docs.render.com/reference/retrieve-postgres-connection-info)
